question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 35, 53, 38, 89, 71, 69, 86, 40 and 41 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take assumed mean = 60

Deviations: −25, −7, −22, +29, +11, +9, +26, −20, −19

Sum of deviations = −18

Mean = 60 + (−18/9)

**∴ Answer = 58**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations = 35, 53, 38, 89, 71, 69, 86, 40, 41

**Formula used:**

Mean = (Sum of observations) ÷ Number of observations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum = 35 + 53 + 38 + 89 + 71 + 69 + 86 + 40 + 41

⇒ = 522

⇒ Number of observations = 9

⇒ Mean = 522 ÷ 9 = 58

**∴ The correct answer is 58.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

Mean = Total sum ÷ number of values

Assumed Mean Method

Use a central value to simplify calculations

Quick Check

Mean should lie within range of data
